mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.group_learning_outcomes (id, code, description, sort_order, course_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{code}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, #{courseId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.group_learning_outcomes SET code = #{code}, description = #{description}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, course_id = #{courseId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, description, sort_order, course_id, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.group_learning_outcomes WHERE course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY sort_order, created_at, id
